title.romaji: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu

synopsis: Kyoutarou Ichikawa may look like a shy, reserved middle schooler, but in truth, his mind is consumed by morbid fantasies of murder—chiefly targeting Anna Yamada, the school idol. However, as he observes her snacking and acting goofy in the library, his obsession steadily morphs into genuine affection.
